ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ مِنْهُ انْشَقَّتِ الْأَسْرَارُ ، وَانْفَلَقَتِ الْأَنْوَارُ ، وَفِيْهِ ارْتَقَتِ الْحَقَائِقُ ، وَتَنَزَّلَتْ عُلُوْمُ آدَمَ فَأَعْجَزَ الْخَلَائِقَ ، وَلَهُ تَضَاءَلَتِ الْفُهُوْمُ ، فَلَمْ يُدْرِكْهُ مِنَّا سَابِقٌ وَلَا لَاحِقٌ ،
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli `alā man minhu ‘nshaqqati al-asrāru, Wa ‘nfalaqati ‘l-anwāru, Wa fīhi ‘rtaqati ‘l-ḥaqā’iqu, Wa tanazzalat `ulūmu Ādama fa’a`jaza ‘l-khalā’iqa, Wa lahū taḍā’alati ‘l-fuhūmu falam yudrikhu minnā sābiqun wa lā lāḥiq,
en: O Allah send prayers upon the one from whom the secrets spring forth, the lights burst out, in whom all realities were sewn, ceasing the knowledge of Adam, paralyzing all creatures, and reducing understanding so that none of us of the former or later could reach him,
